name: Branch of Cenarius
summary: The Branch of Cenarius is a sacred dryad relic stolen by the vile satyr Geltharis in eastern Ashenvale. Recovering this heirloom was the dying wish of the dryad Anilia, who perished defending it from the woods' corruptors.

sections.title: A Sacred Bough Fallen to Shadow
sections.body: Revered by the daughters of Cenarius, the Branch of Cenarius represents both the blessing of the Forest Lord and the deep connection his dryads maintain with Ashenvale. The branch was held in high regard by the dryad sisters Anilia and Illiyana until a band of corrupt satyrs ambushed them. The satyr leader, Geltharis, seized the relic and mortally wounded Anilia near the tainted ruins of eastern Ashenvale. With her dying breaths, Anilia pointed northward toward the arch where Geltharis lurks, pleading for a champion to wrest the sacred bough from his claws and restore it to dryad hands at Forest Song.

faq.q: What is the Branch of Cenarius?
faq.answer: The Branch of Cenarius is a treasured nature relic cherished by the dryads of Ashenvale. Bearing the namesake and blessing of the demigod Cenarius, it serves as a holy symbol of their stewardship over the ancient forest.

faq.q: Who stole the Branch of Cenarius?
faq.answer: The relic was stolen by the vile satyr Geltharis, who led an ambush against the dryads near eastern Ashenvale. Geltharis struck down the dryad Anilia and fled beyond a stone arch to the north with the branch in his clutches.

faq.q: Who does the branch belong to?
aliases: who do i give it to
faq.answer: The branch belongs to the dryads of Forest Song. With Anilia having perished defending it, the relic is returned to her grieving sister, Illiyana, fulfilling Anilia's dying wish.
The branch is found on Geltharis, lurking just north of the ruins where Anilia collapses in eastern Ashenvale, near the border with Azshara.

angles.text: As disciples of Cenarius, druids feel a personal duty to reclaim any artifact bearing the Forest Lord's name from defilement by the demonic satyr.
For the night elves of Ashenvale, aiding the dryads and recovering their lost ancestral treasures is a sacred obligation to nature.
